-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.DurableLogView` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem raftState_logView [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (id : w64) (S : RaftState) (N :
    Namespace) : isCluster γ N ∗ raftState γ id S ⊢ |={⊤}=> raftState γ id S ∗ ∃ fp, ⌜FullOk S.base
    fp ∧ PlogWf S.base S.ents ∧ uint.nat S.commit ≤ (fp ++ S.ents).length⌝ ∗ ⌜List.Pairwise (fun a b
    => uint.nat a.Term' ≤ uint.nat b.Term' ∧ uint.nat a.Index' < uint.nat b.Index') (fp ++ S.ents)⌝
    ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ (strip (List.take (uint.nat S.commit) (fp ++ S.ents)))
